sunken_well.title: Sunken Well
sunken_well.body: A blue-green glow rises from the bottom of the old well.
sunken_well.resolved_body: The well has already been searched.

choices.summary: Dungeon: gathered glowing moss from the sunken well.
choices.result: The moss comes loose in soft blue strands.

choices.summary: Dungeon: passed an agility check and reached a hidden ledge.
choices.result: The party reaches a hidden ledge and finds an ancient shard.

choices.summary: Dungeon: found a machine gear in the old well.
choices.result: The lockbox contains a preserved machine gear.

collapsed_mine.title: Collapsed Mine
collapsed_mine.body: Loose stone blocks the mine, but iron veins are visible through the cracks.
collapsed_mine.resolved_body: Only loose rubble remains in the mine.

choices.summary: Dungeon: mined iron ore from the collapsed tunnel.
choices.result: The pack grows heavy with iron ore.

choices.summary: Dungeon: passed a strength check and cleared the deeper tunnel.
choices.result: Beyond the boulder are more ore and a machine gear.

choices.summary: Dungeon: activated a mine lever; a distant gate moved.
choices.result: A stone gate rumbles somewhere far away.

sealed_gate.title: Sealed Gate
sealed_gate.body: The gate bears the crest of the old capital. The seal is still active.
sealed_gate.resolved_body: The gate runes have already been recorded.

choices.summary: Dungeon: recorded the sealed gate runes and recovered a shard.
choices.result: A loose shard breaks away from the old inscription.

choices.summary: Dungeon: passed an intelligence check and weakened the seal.
choices.result: The seal loosens and high-grade ancient shards fall free.

shadow_patrol.title: Shadow Patrol
shadow_patrol.body: Shadows patrol the ruined street. The party can avoid them or fight.
shadow_patrol.resolved_body: The patrol route has already been handled.

choices.text: Avoid the patrol and search supplies
choices.summary: Dungeon: avoided the shadow patrol and found supplies.
choices.result: The party avoids combat and finds an old coin pouch.

choices.summary: Dungeon: passed an agility check and found hidden supplies.
choices.result: The party slips through the patrol line at the perfect moment.

choices.summary: Dungeon: marked a future combat point.
choices.result: The patrol route is marked on the map.

choices.summary: Dungeon: defeated the shadow patrol and recovered supplies.
choices.result: The patrol blocks the road and combat begins.

old_shrine.title: Old Shrine
old_shrine.body: The stone lantern beside the shrine is still warm.
old_shrine.resolved_body: The shrine has already answered the party.

choices.summary: Dungeon: found an ancient shard and a machine gear at the shrine.
choices.result: A hidden compartment opens beneath the lantern.

choices.summary: Dungeon: used magic to reveal the shrine offering.
choices.result: Blue-white flame reveals three ancient shards.

choices.summary: Dungeon: defeated the shrine guardian and took the offering.
choices.result: The guardian rises from the stone floor.

crystal_ward_gate.title: Crystal Ward Gate
crystal_ward_gate.body: A warded gate hums beneath the old capital, pointing toward a second map.

choices.summary: Dungeon: passed through the crystal ward gate to the cavern.
choices.result: The ruins bend into a cold tunnel of blue crystal.
The party marks the gate and keeps exploring nearby.

cavern_return_gate.title: Return Gate
cavern_return_gate.body: The matching ward gate points back toward the old capital streets.

choices.summary: Dungeon: returned from the crystal cavern to the old capital.
choices.result: The crystal tunnel folds back into broken stone streets.
The party keeps searching the crystal cavern.

crystal_garden.title: Crystal Garden
crystal_garden.body: Pale plants grow between crystal roots, each leaf holding a drop of light.
crystal_garden.resolved_body: Only dim crystal roots remain in the garden.

choices.summary: Dungeon: harvested luminous moss in the crystal garden.
choices.result: The moss keeps glowing after it is packed away.

choices.summary: Dungeon: cut crystal samples from the cavern garden.
choices.result: A hard crystal vein breaks into usable ancient shards.

mana_spring.title: Mana Spring
mana_spring.body: A shallow spring reflects constellations that are not above the cavern.
mana_spring.resolved_body: The spring has already offered its clearest fragments.

choices.summary: Dungeon: collected ancient shards from the mana spring.
choices.result: The water clears, leaving two ancient shards in the basin.

choices.summary: Dungeon: read the reflected star map in the mana spring.
choices.result: The reflected stars reveal a route through the deeper cavern.

deep_crystal_nest.title: Deep Crystal Nest
deep_crystal_nest.body: Cracked crystals gather around old armor marks. Something nested here recently.
deep_crystal_nest.resolved_body: The crystal nest has already been cleared.

choices.summary: Dungeon: recovered abandoned gear from the crystal nest.
choices.result: A rusted gear assembly is still usable after some cleaning.

choices.summary: Dungeon: defeated shadows in the crystal nest.
choices.result: Shadows gather around the cracked crystals.
